text: Owner accepted the proposed #6542 FILETOSTR fix approach. I recorded it at https://github.com/rhamenator/Project-Copperfin/issues/6542#issuecomment-5822798337 : classify the actually opened object via POSIX fstat or Windows handle metadata/open error, read from that handle, distinguish EOF from failures, map errors to catchable VFP-compatible file faults, preserve verified-byte admission; special-file policy remains separate.
